notes: The tree is drawn as vector boxes with live text (labels like 'Froiloba Bermúdez'/'Flaín Muñoz' are text-layer extractable, not raster), which raised doubt about whether it can surface as an image-kind chunk at all. Checked with evidence, not assumption: indexed cid-valencia.pdf alone into a throwaway FAISS collection via the real pipeline (ensure_indexed/IndexCorpus/MineruImageExtractor, same code this probe uses) and read the store directly. Result: MinerU's content-list classifies the tree region as its own `image` block (1343x371px) distinct from the page's two decorative photos (the donation-diploma scan and the Burgos equestrian statue, both un-captioned), and it is indexed with format='image' on page 2 -- confirming this case is measurable as written. The tree's own caption ('En la línea de primer grado se muestran las dos variantes más aceptadas sobre los posibles padres de El Cid') is a near-verbatim echo of the question, unlike the page's other two image chunks, which carry no caption text at all -- a real embedding-similarity edge for the tree over its neighbors. Residual limitation, not fixed here: grade.py's grade_retrieval accepts any image-kind hit in top-k without checking which image, so a pass still would not by itself prove the tree (rather than the diploma or the statue) was the one retrieved.
